errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis represents a "percentage change" ("prozentuale Veränderung"). However, the figure itself does not contain a percentage sign (%) or any axis label to confirm this unit. This is an interpretation that goes beyond the explicitly presented visual information.

errors.text_span: Die Skala der x-Achse ist linear
errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis has a linear scale. While the lengths of the bars are proportional to the values, there is no actual scaled axis with tick marks or numerical labels drawn on the chart. Values are only provided via data labels next to the bars.
